claims.text: The hotel is built on a cliff face above the village of Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, between Menton and Monaco, with Mount Agel behind.

findings.quote: has been built on a cliff face above the village of Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, in a convenient location just between Menton and Monaco, with Mount Agel behind.

claims.text: The hotel is a 10-minute drive up a winding road from Monte-Carlo.

findings.quote: A 10-minute drive up the winding road from Monte-Carlo

claims.text: Its modernist architecture rises from the rocky peninsula of Roquebrune-Cap-Martin above the Mediterranean.

findings.quote: The striking modernist architecture of The Maybourne Riviera emerges from the rocky peninsula of Roquebrune-Cap-Martin as if forging its way into the glistening Mediterranean Sea.

claims.text: Every suite and studio opens to views of the Mediterranean, with private balconies.

findings.quote: suites and studios opens to sweeping views of the Mediterranean, with private balconies that catch the light as the sun slowly sets over the glittering sea.

claims.text: All rooms have Smart TVs, Bang & Olufsen Bluetooth speakers and Dyson hairdryers.

findings.quote: All rooms are kitted out with Smart TVs, Bang & Olufson Bluetooth speaker, and Dyson hairdryers.

claims.text: The hotel has an infinity pool with horizon views.

findings.quote: Pause from a day of relaxation by the infinity pool
to the horizon views at The Maybourne Riviera, each of our pools offers a unique sanctuary of calm.

claims.text: Surrenne Riviera, the hotel's wellbeing and longevity destination, has a gym and fitness studio overlooking the Mediterranean, with Lagree and spin classes.

findings.quote: Surrenne Riviera is The Maybourne Riviera’s next generation wellbeing and longevity destination
with an exquisite gym and fitness studio where you can pound the treadmill overlooking the Med, or take Lagree and spin classes surrounded by nothing but blue sky.

claims.text: Every stay includes full access to Surrenne Riviera and daily English breakfast served in the suite or studio, or at the Riviera Restaurant.

findings.quote: Full access to Surrenne Riviera, our wellbeing club, for the duration of your stay
Daily English breakfast, served in your suite or studio, or at the Riviera Restaurant

claims.text: A complimentary shuttle runs to and from Monaco and to the hotel's private beach club.

findings.quote: Complimentary shuttle service to and from Monaco and to our private beach club

claims.text: Suite inclusions include an in-room massage, a sunset cruise and a welcome bottle of chilled champagne.

findings.quote: Suites come with a range of complimentary inclusions - moments of quiet indulgence like an in-room massage, a sunset cruise and a seasonal welcome with a complimentary bottle of chilled champagne waiting on arrival.

claims.text: The Riviera Restaurant has panoramic sea views and serves seasonal, local cuisine inspired by the Mediterranean.

findings.quote: Enjoy our spectacular panoramic sea view restaurant, while savoring seasonal and local cuisine inspired by the Mediterranean.

claims.text: abc kitchens riviera, by Chef Jean-Georges, blends Mediterranean flavours with New York flair on the top floor.

findings.quote: abc kitchens riviera by Chef Jean-Georges blends Mediterranean flavours with New York flair on the top floor.

claims.text: Every room has 180-degree views of the Mediterranean and the coastline stretching from Italy to Monaco.

findings.quote: every room of the hotel has access to 180-degree uninterrupted vistas of the Mediterranean sea and coastline stretching from Italy all the way along to the Principality and beyond.

claims.text: Duplex suites come with private plunge pools and large furnished terraces, and the signature suites are individually designed.

findings.quote: A step up are the beautiful duplex suites accompanied by private plunge pools and large furnished terraces
the spectacular, individually designed signature suites.

claims.text: The Surrenne Riviera spa has a sauna, a steam room and a cold plunge out on the terrace.

findings.quote: The spa has been finished with a sauna, steam, and cold plunge out on the terrace
New for summer 2025 is Surrenne Riviera

claims.text: Complimentary experiences include Pilates and sunrise yoga, cocktail and pizza-making masterclasses, guided hikes on the Le Corbusier Trail and cultural outings to Roquebrune-Cap-Martin.

findings.quote: Exclusive access to our private beach club, with complimentary sun loungers, during the summer season, subject to availability
